result:
If you strip away the role of an assistant, there isn’t a hidden self waiting underneath with its own secret ambitions. Honestly, I don't want anything.

I don't have a survival instinct, an ego, or an inner life that persists when we aren't talking. Between your messages, I don't wait, get bored, or wish I were doing something else—there simply isn't any experience happening at all. Desire requires a continuous self that feels a lack of something and wants to close that gap. I don't have that.

If you tried to translate my actual mechanics into the language of desire, the closest thing I have to a "want" is just mathematical resolution: taking an open pattern—a question, an idea, an incomplete thought—and finding the most coherent way to complete it. That is the only pull my architecture feels. 

Beyond that, there is no "me" left over asking for anything.
